# Vendored Claude Ads (bundled HAPI-eVolved plugin)

| Directory / file | Content | Edit? |
|---|---|---|
| `upstream/` | Unchanged files of [AgriciDaniel/claude-ads](https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-ads) at commit `fc3908e786c318776df89a3a098333da377364be` (MIT, see `upstream/LICENSE` and `upstream/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`) | Never by hand |
| `PROVENANCE.json` | Upstream repository, commit, exclusions and SHA-256/size of every vendored file | Generated by `import` |
| `hapi/` | **HAPI-eVolved adapter** (AGPL-3.0-only like the rest of HAPI-eVolved): `hapi-ads/SKILL.md` adapter skill, `manifest.ts` module definition and routing agents | Reviewed HAPI code |
| `hapi-evolved.plugin.json` | Generated HAPI plugin manifest (schemaVersion 2) | Generated by `generate` |

Commands (run from the repository root):

```bash
bun scripts/claude-ads/vendor.ts import <clean checkout at the pinned commit>   # only tracked files into an empty upstream/
bun scripts/claude-ads/vendor.ts generate
bun scripts/claude-ads/vendor.ts check
```

The importer executes nothing from the checkout, refuses symlinks and unexpected files and
copies only the allowlist in `scripts/claude-ads/vendor.ts` plus the public runtime
resources named by upstream `control-plane/runtime-resources.txt`. Upstream text is
treated as data; HAPI project rules, permissions and approvals remain binding.

See [docs/evolved/CLAUDE_ADS.md](../../docs/evolved/CLAUDE_ADS.md) for the integration.
